prompt: In a soft watercolor illustration, a beach volleyball tournament unfolds under a pale sky. On the left stands a tall player in blue shorts, mid-air with one arm raised high to spike the ball. In the center, a referee in a striped shirt sits on a high chair, pointing firmly toward the right side of the court. Next to the referee, a small brown dog sits calmly on the sand, looking up at the official. On the right, a spectator in a yellow hat leans forward, watching the intense play with focused eyes. Beside this spectator lies a red cooler, its lid slightly ajar. The tall player in blue shorts is positioned directly opposite the spectator in the yellow hat across the net. The small brown dog is situated immediately next to the referee in the striped shirt. There is no visible scoreboard in the background. The scene captures the dynamic motion and casual atmosphere of the match through fluid washes of color, highlighting the distinct figures and their specific actions without clutter or distraction.
